sloka: स धन्यो यस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ ।श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयो: स्पृहयामहे ॥ २.११२.३॥
transliteration: sa dhanyo yasya putrau dvau dharmajñau dharmavikramau ।śrutvā vayaṁ hi sambhāṣāmubhayo: spṛhayāmahe ॥ 2.112.3॥

translations.english: On hearing their dialogue we are deeply drawn towards them, these two sons of king Dasaratha who was fortunate to have these practioners of righteousness and whose strength is dharma.
